title: Will Affective Computing Emerge from Foundation Models and General AI? A First Evaluation on ChatGPT
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion. The benchmarks measured performance on affective computing tasks: big-five personality prediction, sentiment analysis, and suicide tendency detection.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion.
